data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10; this is not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next is500 or100. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term. Who opts in?
